display.purpose: Brand wordmark, auth hero and a few brand moments (empty-library hero, year headings). Chakra Petch.

headline.purpose: Page titles (1.5rem) and panel titles (1rem). Inter, sentence case.

body.purpose: Descriptions, metadata, form copy. Inter at 0.875–0.9375rem.

label.purpose: Platform chips only use uppercase; everything else is sentence case.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Covers and shelf art at rest.

shadows.name: shadow-card-hover
shadows.purpose: Lift + blue rim on interactive card hover.

shadows.name: shadow-accent
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons and the brand crystal.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Save, add game, log session — one solid blue fill per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; background: #2a56e8; color: #fff; font: 650 0.875rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(59,103,245,0.5), 0 6px 18px rgba(59,103,245,0.24); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3b67f5; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #1f45c4; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9bb7ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions: Cancel, Edit, Clear filters.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color: #f5f8ff; font: 650 0.875rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid rgba(148,170,214,0.24); border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(59,103,245,0.12); border-color: rgba(59,103,245,0.5); }

components.name: Status Action
components.description: Card footer button that names the next action (Start playing / Pause / Resume / Add to library), tinted by the game's status tone.
components.css: .ds-status-action { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; background: rgba(34,211,238,0.1); color: #a5f3fc; border: 1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.4); border-radius: 12px; font: 700 0.8125rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-status-action:hover { background: rgba(34,211,238,0.2); }

components.name: Genre Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 11px; background: rgba(59,103,245,0.12); color: #dbe5ff; font: 600 0.75rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid rgba(59,103,245,0.3); border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The single content surface for detail, profile, insights and history.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 20px; background: #101a2e; border: 1px solid rgba(148,170,214,0.14); border-radius: 16px; } .ds-panel__title { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 700 1rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #f5f8ff; } .ds-panel__body { margin: 0; color: #c9d4e8; font: 0.875rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Brand
components.description: Save-point crystal + Chakra Petch wordmark in the sidebar.
components.css: .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 16px; background: #0b1222; } .ds-brand__mark { color: #3b67f5; font-size: 1.5rem; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(59,103,245,0.45)); } .ds-brand__name { font: 700 1.25rem 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #f5f8ff; }

narrative.overview: Savepoint is a power-user game library tool. It behaves like Steam or GOG — dense metadata, fast filters, scannable grids — wrapped in deep navy with one confident blue. The save-point crystal and a light game-literate voice ("No save data found", "GG!", "progress saved") give it personality in moments, never at the expense of the task.
keyCharacteristics: Deep-navy layered surfaces (base → surface → elevated → overlay)
One dark-blue accent for primary actions, selection and focus
Status tones (cyan / amber / green / pink / slate) via [data-status], always paired with a label or icon
Inter for all UI; Chakra Petch only for brand moments
Action buttons name what happens next, not the current state
WCAG AA+ everywhere, AAA on body copy

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Solid Savepoint blue appears once per view on the primary action. Everything else uses tints of it.

rules.name: The Readable Dark Rule
rules.body: Body text #c9d4e8+ on #101a2e; muted copy #9aa8c2 (7:1). No gray-on-navy below 4.5:1, placeholders included.

rules.name: The Brand Gate
rules.body: Chakra Petch is for the wordmark and a few brand moments only — never buttons, labels, or data.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; lift and glow respond to hover, focus, or the primary CTA.

dos: Do use the shared primitives (.btn, .icon-btn, .panel, .chip, .status-pill, .stat-strip) before writing new styles.
Do drive status color through [data-status] + --tone tokens.
Do label buttons with the action they perform.
donts: Don't hardcode hex/rgba colors in components — use tokens from src/theme/variables.scss.
Don't use gradient text, side-stripe borders, or uppercase eyebrows on sections.
Don't duplicate navigation controls in the same viewport.
Don't disable submit buttons to signal invalid input — validate on submit and point to the field.
